BiblicalUsage: ʼĕlâhh is the word for God. In Ezra 5:1, the text says "prophesied unto the Jews that [were] in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel." In Jeremiah 10:11, the text says "The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading ʼĕlâhh this way, I believe God is who He says He is, and His name carries everything He is. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
